claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: HA-1004 is a weak, non-selective protein kinase inhibitor (PKA/PKC) and calcium antagonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells, as it shows no cytotoxicity in the described screens and its known activities are cytostatic/functional rather than cytotoxic.
